register its ownership and parent, and require"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" its own source reads. Preserve reports in
the shared record, return to the same child for a focused"},{"id":"p30s3","text":" second pass, and independently

test routes, and un"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"known areas. Read before editing and synchronize after verification.

- Epistemics: "},{"id":"p30s9","text":"distinguish observation, inference, and
uncertainty; recover tacit constraints and turn newly expose"},{"id":"p30s10","text":"d gaps into specific probes."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The existing workspace operations—introspection, directed focus, reasoning bridges, broadcast,
